name: Lightware LW2

actions.name: Switch one input to one output

options.label: Input
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: Input 1..N with number ids, N = config "Input Count" (default 40, 0..100); labels are replaced by the names read from the device ({iname#n=?}).

options.label: Output
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: Output 1..M with number ids, M = number of outputs the device reports in its "(ALL ...)" crosspoint line (autodetected after connect). Labels are replaced by the names read from the device ({oname#n=?}).

notes: Complete list: 3 actions (initActions) and 1 boolean feedback (initFeedbacks), both in index.js. Actions "preset" and "savepreset" only exist after the device has reported presets; the action definitions are rebuilt whenever names or presets are received.

Protocol: legacy Lightware LW2 over a TCP socket on fixed port 10001 (TCPHelper, host from config "Device IP"). Commands: "{<in>@<out>}" (switch), "{%<n>}" (load preset), "{$<n>}" (save preset), each followed by CRLF.

All dropdown lists are filled at runtime (CHOICES_INPUTS / CHOICES_OUTPUTS / CHOICES_PRESETS) and are therefore recorded with choicesNote, valueType number and min. The feedback is registered at init with still-empty lists and re-registered when the device reports its outputs; ids are numbers, defaults are the number 1.
The input max 100 is the upper limit of the "Input Count" config field, not a limit of the action.
Presets (button presets for every input/output pair and for presets) and variables are not catalogued.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.12.1: options do not support expressions.
